title: Maximum Spending After Buying Items
description:
Given an `m x n` matrix `values`, row `i` describes the items in shop `i`, sorted in non-increasing order of value. Every cell represents a separate item, including cells with equal values.

On day `d`, starting at day 1, buy exactly one item from any shop that still has items. You must buy that shop's rightmost remaining item, paying its value multiplied by `d`. Return the maximum total spending after buying every item.

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: values = [[8, 5, 2], [6, 4, 1], [9, 7, 3]]
Output: 285
```

### Example 2

```text
Input: values = [[10, 8, 6, 4, 2], [9, 7, 5, 3, 2]]
Output: 386
```

## Constraints

- 1 <= m == values.length <= 10
- 1 <= n == values[i].length <= 10^4
- 1 <= values[i][j] <= 10^6
- values[i] are sorted in non-increasing order.
